digest.component_or_area: Cloud ACLI graph whole-project readers (acli_graph.py pagination)
propositions: The three Cloud whole-project readers get_parent_map, get_comment_map, and get_issuelinks_map have no test exercising more than one page of pagination.
The same pagination defect class was fixed three separate times on the DC/shared side, but the Cloud copies of these readers were never tested past their first page.
Silent truncation in these whole-project reads is invisible because the symptom is missing parents/comments/links feeding the differ, not an error.
The DC structural AST guard scans only the DC transport source, so a fourth unpaginated caller can be added silently on Cloud.
Tests must assert every seeded item is recovered across multiple pages, that the cursor advances by echoing the returned token, and that termination occurs on both isLast and null nextPageToken.
A repeated cursor token must not loop forever, and new tests must be mutation-checked so breaking the loop after the first page turns them red.
